name: OPTION_REQUIRED
message: Required option '{option}' is missing in node '{node}'
hint: Add '{option}' to the node, or set it in env or in the cluster defaults.

name: OPTION_INVALID
message: Option '{option}' of node '{node}' has the invalid value '{value}': {reason}
hint: Check the type and the allowed range of '{option}' on the plugin page.

name: NATIVE_KEY_CONTROLLED
message: Native option '{key}' of node '{node}' is controlled by PipeForge and cannot be set: {reason}
hint: Remove '{key}' from the native options; use the corresponding PipeForge option instead.

name: VARIABLE_UNDEFINED
message: Variable '${{variable}}' is not defined
hint: Define it in env.variables or pass a value when running the job, or give a default: ${{variable}:-default}.

name: SECRET_NOT_FOUND
message: Secret '{secret}' does not exist
hint: Create the secret first, or check its name and the project it belongs to.

name: JOB_INVALID
message: The job definition is invalid at {location}: {reason}
hint: Compare the job with the job DSL reference; the location gives the line, column and path of the problem.

name: REQUEST_INVALID
message: The request is invalid: {reason}
hint: Compare the request with the API reference; the reason names the field or the endpoint.

name: EXPRESSION_ERROR
message: Expression '{expression}' failed: {reason}
hint: Guard the expression (for example NULLIF(qty, 0) or TRY_CAST), or set on-error to null or fail on the node.

name: DAG_CYCLE
message: The job contains a cycle: {path}
hint: Change the inputs of the nodes on this path so that data flows in one direction only.

name: SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE
message: Node '{node}' cannot accept the schema produced by '{upstream}': {reason}
hint: Map or cast the columns with a field-mapper transform, or adjust the target table.

name: DELIVERY_UNSUPPORTED
message: Exactly-once delivery is required, but sink '{node}' only supports {guarantee}
hint: Use a sink that supports two-phase commit or idempotent writes, or lower the delivery guarantee.

name: ROUTE_CONFLICT
message: Routes {routes} write to table '{table}' with schemas that cannot be merged
hint: Make the column types compatible with type hints, or route the tables to different targets.

name: UPSERT_REQUIRES_PK
message: Sink '{node}' receives changes for table '{table}', which has no primary key
hint: Declare the key columns with the sink's primary-key option, or write append-only data.

name: CHANGELOG_INCOMPATIBLE
message: Node '{node}' accepts {accepted} streams but receives a {produced} stream from '{upstream}'
hint: Use a sink that accepts updates, or convert the stream before this node.

name: EXPRESSION_INVALID
message: Invalid expression '{expression}' at line {line}, column {column}: {reason}
hint: Check the syntax, the column names and the argument types of the functions.

name: ROLLBACK_UNSUPPORTED
message: Sink '{node}' does not support the rollback mode '{mode}'
hint: Choose a rollback mode the sink supports, or disable rollback for this job.

name: INPUT_INVALID
message: Node '{node}' cannot read from '{input}': {reason}
hint: List the ids of source or transform nodes in inputs; sinks produce no data.

name: NODE_DISCONNECTED
message: The output of node '{node}' does not reach any sink
hint: Add '{node}' to the inputs of a downstream node, or remove it from the job.

name: BOUNDEDNESS_MISMATCH
message: The job runs in batch mode, but source '{node}' is unbounded
hint: Remove env.mode to derive the mode from the sources, set it to streaming, or configure the source to stop.

name: PLUGIN_NOT_FOUND
message: The {type} plugin '{plugin}' is not installed
hint: Install the plugin into the plugins directory, or check the spelling of its name.

name: PLUGIN_API_INCOMPATIBLE
message: Plugin '{plugin}' requires connector API {required}, but this engine provides {provided}
hint: Install a plugin version built for this engine version.

name: DRIVER_MISSING
message: Plugin '{plugin}' needs the driver '{driver}', which is not installed
hint: Upload the driver; drivers with restrictive licenses are not shipped with PipeForge.

name: PLUGIN_LOAD_FAILED
message: Plugin '{plugin}' cannot be loaded: {reason}
hint: Check that the plugin package is complete and was built for this engine version.

name: PLUGIN_FORBIDDEN_CALL
message: Plugin '{plugin}' calls {call} in {location}, which changes the whole JVM
hint: Plugins must not exit the JVM or change global settings; pass configuration through options instead.

name: PLUGIN_TIMEOUT
message: Plugin '{plugin}' did not finish {operation} within {timeoutMs} ms
hint: Check whether the external system responds; raise the timeout only if the operation is legitimately slow.

name: PLUGIN_CALL_FAILED
message: Plugin '{plugin}' failed in {operation}: {reason}
hint: See the cause in the error details; report it to the plugin vendor if it looks like a defect.

name: COMPONENT_AMBIGUOUS
message: The {type} '{identifier}' is provided by several plugins: {plugins}
hint: Choose one with the plugin field of the node, for example plugin: {identifier}@1.0.0.

name: INTERNAL
message: Internal error: {detail}
hint: This is a bug. Please report it with the error details and the log of the run.
